text: The unit step response of a system with the transfer function [latex]G(s)=\frac{1-2s}{1+s}[/latex] is given by which one of the following waveforms?
html: The unit step response of a system with the transfer function [latex]G(s)=\frac{1-2s}{1+s}[/latex] is given by which one of the following waveforms?
subject: Control Systems - Time Response Analysis
explanation_text: [latex]T.F.=\frac{1-2s}{1+s} [/latex] [latex]C(s)=\frac{1-2s}{1+s}\cdot \frac{1}{s} [/latex] [latex]\;\;=\frac{A}{1+s}+\frac{B}{s} [/latex] For A, [latex]A=\lim_{s \to -1}(s+1)\cdot \frac{1-2s}{s(1+s)} [/latex] [latex]\;\;=\frac{(1-2(-1))}{(-1)}=-3 [/latex] For B, [latex]B=\lim_{s \to 0}s\cdot \frac{1-2s}{s(1+s)}=1 [/latex] [latex]C(s)=\frac{1}{s}-\frac{3}{1+s} [/latex] [latex]C(t)=(1-3e^{-t})u(t)[/latex]
explanation_html:
[latex]T.F.=\frac{1-2s}{1+s} [/latex]
[latex]C(s)=\frac{1-2s}{1+s}\cdot \frac{1}{s} [/latex]
[latex]\;\;=\frac{A}{1+s}+\frac{B}{s} [/latex]
For A,
[latex]A=\lim_{s \to -1}(s+1)\cdot \frac{1-2s}{s(1+s)} [/latex]
[latex]\;\;=\frac{(1-2(-1))}{(-1)}=-3 [/latex]
For B,
[latex]B=\lim_{s \to 0}s\cdot \frac{1-2s}{s(1+s)}=1 [/latex]
[latex]C(s)=\frac{1}{s}-\frac{3}{1+s} [/latex]
[latex]C(t)=(1-3e^{-t})u(t)[/latex]

text: An open loop transfer function G(s) of a system is [latex]G(s)=\frac{K}{s(s+1)(s+2)}[/latex] For a unity feedback system, the breakaway point of the root loci on the real axis occurs at,
html:
An open loop transfer function G(s) of a system is
[latex]G(s)=\frac{K}{s(s+1)(s+2)}[/latex]
For a unity feedback system, the breakaway point of the root loci on the real axis occurs at,
subject: Control Systems - Root Locus Techniques
explanation_text: [latex]G_1(s)=\frac{k}{s(s+1)(s+2)} [/latex] [latex]\Rightarrow \;\; 1+\frac{k}{s(s+1)(s+2)}=0 [/latex] [latex]\Rightarrow \;\; s(s^2+3s+2)+k=0 [/latex] [latex]\Rightarrow \;\; s^3+3s^2+2s+k=0 [/latex] [latex]\Rightarrow \;\; k=-s^3-3s^2-2s\;\;\;...(i) [/latex] [latex]\Rightarrow \;\;\frac{dk}{ds}=0[/latex] [latex] \;\;\;\;\frac{dk}{ds}=-3s^2-6s-2=0[/latex] [latex] \;\;\;\;s=-0.422,-1.577[/latex] Only s=-0.422 lie on root locus. Therefore brakaway point is s=-0.42.
explanation_html:
[latex]G_1(s)=\frac{k}{s(s+1)(s+2)} [/latex]
[latex]\Rightarrow \;\; 1+\frac{k}{s(s+1)(s+2)}=0 [/latex]
[latex]\Rightarrow \;\; s(s^2+3s+2)+k=0 [/latex]
[latex]\Rightarrow \;\; s^3+3s^2+2s+k=0 [/latex]
[latex]\Rightarrow \;\; k=-s^3-3s^2-2s\;\;\;...(i) [/latex]
[latex]\Rightarrow \;\;\frac{dk}{ds}=0[/latex]
[latex] \;\;\;\;\frac{dk}{ds}=-3s^2-6s-2=0[/latex]
[latex] \;\;\;\;s=-0.422,-1.577[/latex]

Only s=-0.422 lie on root locus. Therefore brakaway point is s=-0.42.

text: For the system governed by the set of equations: [latex]dx_{1}/dt=2x_{1}+x_{2}+u [/latex] [latex]dx_{2}/dt=-2x_{1}+u [/latex] [latex] y=3x_{1}[/latex] the transfer function Y(s)/U(s) is given by
html:
For the system governed by the set of equations:
[latex]dx_{1}/dt=2x_{1}+x_{2}+u [/latex]
[latex]dx_{2}/dt=-2x_{1}+u [/latex]
[latex] y=3x_{1}[/latex]
the transfer function Y(s)/U(s) is given by
subject: Control Systems - Mathematical Models of Physical Systems
explanation_text: [latex]\frac{dx_1}{dt}=2x_1+x_2+u\;\;\;...(i) [/latex] [latex]\frac{dx_2}{dt}=-2x_1+4\;\;\;\;...(ii)[/latex] From equation (i), [latex]sx_1=2x_1+x_2+u [/latex] [latex]sx_2=-2x_1+u [/latex] [latex]x_2=\left ( -\frac{2x_1+u}{s} \right ) [/latex] [latex]sx_1=2x_1+\left ( -\frac{2x_1+u}{s} \right )+4 [/latex] [latex]sx_1-2x_1+\frac{2x_1}{s}=\frac{4}{5}+4 [/latex] [latex]x_1\left ( s-2+\frac{2}{s} \right )=u\left (1+\frac{1}{s} \right ) [/latex] [latex]\frac{x_1}{4}=\frac{\left ( 1+\frac{1}{s} \right )}{\left ( s-2+\frac{2}{s} \right )} [/latex] [latex]\Rightarrow \;\;\frac{y}{u}=\frac{3x-1}{u}=\frac{3\left ( 1+\frac{1}{s} \right )}{\left ( s-2+\frac{2}{s} \right )} [/latex] [latex]\Rightarrow \;\;\frac{y}{u}=\frac{3(s+1)}{(s^2-2s+2)}[/latex]
explanation_html:
[latex]\frac{dx_1}{dt}=2x_1+x_2+u\;\;\;...(i) [/latex]
[latex]\frac{dx_2}{dt}=-2x_1+4\;\;\;\;...(ii)[/latex]
From equation (i),
[latex]sx_1=2x_1+x_2+u [/latex]
[latex]sx_2=-2x_1+u [/latex]
[latex]x_2=\left ( -\frac{2x_1+u}{s} \right ) [/latex]
[latex]sx_1=2x_1+\left ( -\frac{2x_1+u}{s} \right )+4 [/latex]
[latex]sx_1-2x_1+\frac{2x_1}{s}=\frac{4}{5}+4 [/latex]
[latex]x_1\left ( s-2+\frac{2}{s} \right )=u\left (1+\frac{1}{s} \right ) [/latex]
[latex]\frac{x_1}{4}=\frac{\left ( 1+\frac{1}{s} \right )}{\left ( s-2+\frac{2}{s} \right )} [/latex]
[latex]\Rightarrow \;\;\frac{y}{u}=\frac{3x-1}{u}=\frac{3\left ( 1+\frac{1}{s} \right )}{\left ( s-2+\frac{2}{s} \right )} [/latex]
[latex]\Rightarrow \;\;\frac{y}{u}=\frac{3(s+1)}{(s^2-2s+2)}[/latex]
